nodes.label: fetch_tech_news MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Fetches trending tech articles from Hacker News Algolia API with fallback to cached saved_articles.json

nodes.label: manage_local_library MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Manages saved_articles.json with deduplication by URL and check_duplicates/save_new actions

nodes.label: render_prefab_dashboard MCP Tool
nodes.rationale: Compiles articles into self-contained HTML dashboard with chart support (Bar, Line, Area, Pie, Radar, Radial), cached in _LAST_DASHBOARD_HTML

nodes.label: GET /dashboard route
nodes.rationale: Serves cached prefab dashboard HTML with theme injection via query parameter (dark|light)

nodes.label: mcpInitialize function
nodes.rationale: Initializes MCP session with streamable-HTTP transport, manages mcp-session-id header for continuity and auto-recovery

nodes.label: loadMcpTools function
nodes.rationale: POSTs to http://localhost:8000/mcp tools/list endpoint, converts MCP tool schema to Gemini functionDeclarations

nodes.label: Agentic Loop
nodes.rationale: Chains Gemini generateContent with functionCall detection, routes to callMcpTool, repeats up to 12 turns

nodes.label: callMcpTool function
nodes.rationale: Proxies Gemini functionCall to POST http://localhost:8000/mcp tools/call with streamable-HTTP protocol

nodes.label: Dashboard iframe injection
nodes.rationale: Sets iframe.src to http://localhost:8000/dashboard?theme=dark|light&t=timestamp after render_prefab_dashboard succeeds

nodes.label: Theme toggle UI
nodes.rationale: Dark/light mode toggle persisted to chrome.storage.local, applied to extension UI and passed to dashboard via query parameter

nodes.label: Native Gemini googleSearch tool
nodes.rationale: Registered alongside MCP functionDeclarations at sidepanel.js:179 as backup web search (not delegated to backend)

nodes.label: Chrome extension icon click handler
nodes.rationale: Service worker that opens side panel on extension icon click via chrome.sidePanel.open

nodes.label: API key settings page
nodes.rationale: One-time setup: saves Gemini API key to chrome.storage.local, retrieved by sidepanel.js at runtime

nodes.label: Side panel HTML structure
nodes.rationale: Persistent UI across tabs: orchestrator prompt input, theme toggle, dashboard iframe container

nodes.label: Options page HTML form
nodes.rationale: One-time Gemini API key input form, submitted to chrome.storage.local

nodes.label: Manifest V3 security & permissions
nodes.rationale: Declares sidePanel, storage permissions; whitelists localhost:8000, googleapis.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net hosts

nodes.label: saved_articles.json local library
nodes.rationale: Shared data structure: [{id, title, url, points, ai_summary, saved_at}], auto-created on first save, deduped by URL

nodes.label: _LAST_DASHBOARD_HTML server cache
nodes.rationale: Backend-side cache: render_prefab_dashboard populates, /dashboard route serves to iframe

nodes.label: Topic palettes & theme system
nodes.rationale: Maps topic keywords to emojis; dashboard theme (dark/light) via route injection; Gemini selects best-match from exact theme list

nodes.label: FastMCP CORS middleware
nodes.rationale: Configured with allow_origins=['*'], MCP protocol headers (mcp-protocol-version, mcp-session-id) explicitly listed in allow_headers

nodes.label: Async Streamable-HTTP client test
nodes.rationale: Verifies backend server connectivity and tool schema via /mcp endpoint

nodes.label: genai.js bundled ES module
nodes.rationale: Bundled copy of @google/genai SDK, no build step required, imported by sidepanel.js

nodes.label: Fallback error handling pattern
nodes.rationale: fetch_tech_news catches exceptions, returns cached data + {status} sentinel, never raises to agent to keep agentic loop running

nodes.label: Streamable-HTTP MCP protocol transport
nodes.rationale: FastMCP uses streamable-HTTP at /mcp endpoint; JavaScript frontend uses async fetch with JSON-RPC 2.0; session continuity via mcp-session-id header

nodes.label: Dynamic MCP to Gemini tool binding
nodes.rationale: sidepanel.js POSTs tools/list at init, converts schema to functionDeclarations, binds both MCP and native googleSearch tool together
nodes.norm_label: dynamic mcp to gemini tool binding

nodes.label: Basic demo flow sequence
nodes.rationale: User prompt → Gemini chains fetch_tech_news → manage_local_library(check_duplicates) → manage_local_library(save_new) → render_prefab_dashboard → dashboard injected into iframe
